From: Jordan Ross <jordan.ross@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API eval - request

Hi Marissa / Redwood team,

I just signed up for the Hosted API evaluation (PLG flow) and our team is hoping to get a quick walkthrough this week to validate latency and routing behavior for a pilot. We started a small test cluster but ran into a couple of integration questions around streaming responses and token accounting.

Preferred windows:
- Tue/Dec 22: 10:00-12:00 PT or 14:00-16:00 PT
- Wed/Dec 23: 09:00-11:00 PT

Attendees from our side: myself (Jordan Ross, Platform Lead), Priya Mehta (Engineering), and our procurement contact (sales@brightlayer.com).

Would someone from Redwood be available for a 30-45 minute demo + Q&A?

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Ross
Platform Lead, BrightLayer Health
jordan.ross@brightlayer.com

--
Attachment: redwood_intro_deck.pdf (slide deck stub)

Hey Jordan - thanks for signing up and for the details. I'm Dev on the SDR team; looping in Marissa (AE) to run the demo.

Available slots that match your windows:
- Tue 22 Dec, 10:30-11:15 PT (30m) - calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=slot1
- Tue 22 Dec, 14:30-15:15 PT (45m) - calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=slot2
- Wed 23 Dec, 09:30-10:15 PT (30m) - calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=slot3

I've attached a short mutual action plan and our intro deck so you can share with the team ahead of time. If none of these work, tell me the best morning/afternoon and I can propose a fresh set.

Best,

Jordan - thanks for the note, excited to connect. Goal for the session: 30-45 minutes covering a short demo (hosted API, streaming, routing fallbacks) + 10-15 minute technical Q&A. Draft agenda:
1) Quick intros (5m)
2) Demo: hosted API + streaming example (10-15m)
3) Discussion: token accounting, routing & fallback policies, recommended quantization for eval (10-15m)
4) Next steps / MAP review (5m)

Proposed slot: Tue 22 Dec, 14:30-15:15 PT - I sent a calendar invite to the attendees you listed. Please confirm who from engineering will join and whether procurement wants a separate 15-minute session to go over contract/terms.

Also: can you share a small example prompt or workload you'd like us to run during the session? That'll help us tailor the demo (latency vs throughput tradeoffs).

Looking forward -
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/marissacole
